verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows Netlify integrating an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) to protect internal apps, deployments, or agents. The closest items are adjacent: generic 'Advanced Security' and password protection claims, team-level access management, and a third-party Clerk template for end-user authentication. None of these documents IdP-backed access control, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
